scope: Single host-agent forward trial of v0.7.0-rc.5; not a DeepSeek endpoint or DSH GUI acceptance test.

visual_review.basis: actual LibreOffice WASM PPTX renders, not SVG proxies
visual_review.initial_review: Viewed all eight r4 pages and read the full exported notes.
visual_review.revision_review: Viewed r7 pages 3, 5 and 8 after unit wrapping, common scale and source-path corrections; confirmed the other five pages were byte-identical to the already viewed pages.
visual_review.final_review: Viewed r9 pages 2 and 4 after tightening the allocation-reporting wording; confirmed the other six pages were byte-identical to r7.
visual_review.result: No remaining blocking issue found within the inspected content and rendering scope.

content_findings: The visible route proceeds from comparison conditions to within-batch evidence and limitations, then to a proposed next experiment; chapter labels and spoken transitions agree.
The 48-record structure, 46 failures and two right-censored records agree with the independent calculation from the raw inputs.

B-batch difference 25622.25 cycles and Welch interval [-13679.80, 64924.30] cycles agree with the independent calculation; positive estimate and zero-crossing interval are not promoted to causal effectiveness or equivalence.
The protocol explicitly excludes randomized cross-batch allocation; within-B random allocation is unreported. Final slides and notes preserve that distinction.
The next-batch design remains a proposal. No mechanism measurement, useful-effect threshold, sample size or completed experiment is fabricated.
visual_findings: The original text-led cover, consistent low-saturation colors, visible fine borders and restrained source treatment establish a formal academic hierarchy.
Raw observation marks, uncertainty intervals, a censoring timeline, an experiment flow and a decision table use distinct structures appropriate to the evidence.
No missing Chinese glyph, text clipping or text overlap was observed on the inspected final pages.
retained_warnings: The scope section is covered by the sample matrix on a combined roadmap page; the automated body-page classification does not count that layout as section content.
Cover whitespace was reviewed and retained for title hierarchy.
Reference-page whitespace was reviewed and retained to separate bibliography and analysis definitions.
reconstruction: The author completed a fresh all-phase run and reported eight byte-identical PNGs. The main session checked the final verification manifest, copied artifact identity and changed-page comparison.
limitations: All data are synthetic teaching material.
Eight minutes is an allocated time budget, not a live rehearsal.
PowerPoint/WPS GUI, the user's DSH session, physical projection and cross-model reliability were not tested.
Automatic checks and a single reviewed example do not establish general scientific correctness or aesthetic success.
